name: built-in
about: The built-in Defaults Profile. Copy it (ovcd profile > my.profile.json), edit it, and pass it with --profile. All values are SI, except speeds, which are in knots. A 'hard' range refuses an input; a 'soft' range accepts it with a warning. Hard ranges are physical limits, and keep every input inside what the engine can compute; a copy may tighten a hard range but never loosen it. Soft ranges are the catalogue's Vessel Class envelopes with headroom.

length_overall_m.basis: catalogue single-hull classes span 32 to 225.5 m

beam_m.basis: catalogue single-hull classes span 4.7 to 28.8 m

moulded_depth_m.basis: moulded depth is keel to main deck at the side. Left out, it is the depth-to-beam ratio of the Cargo times the beam (see depth_to_beam_ratio); the 41 reference vessels with a published depth span 2.2 to 12.5 m

depth_to_beam_ratio.basis: the default moulded depth is this ratio times the beam, at the midpoint of the range in the reference vessels with a published depth: dry bulk and container 0.22 to 0.44 (inland and pushed), liquid 0.22 to 0.38 (inland and pushed), gas 0.44 to 0.66 (nearly all sea-going). Only dry bulk and gas Cargo exist so far; liquid has no Cargo yet. catalogue/depth_rule.md lists every vessel against the rule

length_to_depth_ratio.basis: length over moulded depth above about 25 is a very slender hull for its depth; the reference vessels with a published depth are below it

formation_abreast.basis: catalogue pushed convoys are at most 4 abreast

formation_in_line.basis: catalogue pushed convoys are at most 5 in line

block_coefficient.basis: calibrated box barges span 0.883 to 0.995; widened down for shaped gas hulls; 0.3 is the squat method's validity floor (hard)

min_freeboard_m.basis: must also be less than the moulded depth (hard)

lightship_factor_t_per_m3.basis: calibrated box barges span 0.095 to 0.1223 t/m3 (calibration/factors.yaml)

max_tank_od_m.basis: a design limit of this tool, not an IGC Code rule: a tank is never wider than this, so a wider hull gets more tanks across. Tank length is limited only by length over diameter, at most 7

max_speed_kn.basis: the speed-power grid starts at 1 kn

air_draft_limit_m.basis: catalogue air drafts span 3.0 to 35.5 m

draught_limit_m.basis: catalogue single-hull draughts span 1.0 to 9 m

channel_depth_m.basis: must also be at least the under-keel clearance (hard)
